mapper.select: SELECT d.diet_id dietId, d.serve_date serveDate, d.meal_time mealTime, d.planned_menu_id plannedMenuId, d.actual_menu_id actualMenuId, d.is_matched isMatched, NVL(a.menu_name, p.menu_name) menuName, NVL(a.category, p.category) category, p.menu_name plannedMenuName, r.review_id reviewId FROM tbl_daily_diet d JOIN tbl_menu p ON p.menu_id = d.planned_menu_id LEFT JOIN tbl_menu a ON a.menu_id = d.actual_menu_id LEFT JOIN tbl_menu_review r ON r.diet_id = d.diet_id AND r.userid = #{userid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE d.serve_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + #{dayOffset} ORDER BY CASE NVL(a.category, p.category) WHEN 'MAIN' THEN 1 WHEN 'SIDE' THEN 2 WHEN 'DESSERT' THEN 3 WHEN 'DRINK' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, d.diet_id

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.review_id reviewId, r.menu_id menuId, r.diet_id dietId, r.userid, m.username userName, r.star_score starScore, r.review_text reviewText, r.regdate regDate, r.updatedate updateDate, n.menu_name menuName, n.category, d.meal_time mealTime, d.serve_date serveDate, CASE WHEN r.userid = #{userid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND r.regdate >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND r.regdate < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END editable, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.regdate DESC, r.review_id DESC) rn FROM tbl_menu_review r JOIN tbl_member m ON m.userid = r.userid JOIN tbl_menu n ON n.menu_id = r.menu_id JOIN tbl_daily_diet d ON d.diet_id = r.diet_id ) WHERE rn > (#{cri.pageNum} - 1) * #{cri.amount} AND rn <= #{cri.pageNum} * #{cri.amount} ORDER BY rn
SELECT actual_menu_id FROM tbl_daily_diet WHERE diet_id = #{dietId} AND serve_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND actual_menu_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT menu_id FROM tbl_menu_review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND userid = #{userid}
SELECT menu_id FROM tbl_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_menu_review (review_id, menu_id, diet_id, userid, star_score, review_text, regdate, updatedate) SELECT seq_menu_review.NEXTVAL, actual_menu_id, diet_id, #{userid}, #{starScore}, #{reviewText}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM tbl_daily_diet WHERE diet_id = #{dietId} AND actual_menu_id = #{menuId} AND serve_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_menu_review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND userid = #{userid}
